semiconductor_relevance: Medium — DK-Lok Corporation manufactures fittings and valves that are used in semiconductor applications, particularly in ultra-high purity (UHP) systems.
summary: DK-Lok Corporation is a South Korean manufacturer specializing in fittings and valves, which are critical components in various industrial applications, including the semiconductor sector.
